periods.time: Morning at the Guild before Denatus

name.zh: 上层弥诺陶洛斯传闻造成公会拥挤
name.en: Upper-Floor Minotaur Rumors Crowd the Guild

periods.summary: Adventurers crowd the Guild to confirm rumors that a Minotaur appeared on the 9th floor, even though Minotaurs usually begin appearing around the 15th floor. The news intensifies fear because a similar upper-floor Minotaur incident occurred about a month earlier.
periods.cause: Loki Familia reports a Minotaur sighting in the upper floors, and previous incidents make low-level adventurers fear the dungeon's danger range has changed.
periods.process: Guild staff explain the situation while adventurers gather around the notice boards and service counters seeking information.
periods.outcome: The Guild hall becomes unusually busy, and Eina worries more strongly about Bell because of his past Minotaur encounter.
periods.aftermath: The rumor forms the anxious backdrop for Bell's cheerful Lv.2 report.
periods.significance: Shows the wider danger context in Orario after Bell's Minotaur battle and explains the Guild's heightened concern.
